title: Face AI
oneLiner: Client-side face analysis in the browser—expression hints, age and gender estimates powered by TensorFlow.js.

problem.heading: Problem
problem.description: Sending webcam frames to a remote model raises privacy questions and latency. The goal was a demo that felt instant and kept frames on-device while still showing what modern TF.js models could do in a React shell.

myRole.heading: My role
myRole.description: Integrated the TF.js graph with React lifecycle and camera capture, tuned inference cadence so the UI stayed interactive, and surfaced model confidence in a way that avoided over-claiming accuracy.

solution.heading: Solution
solution.description: Face AI loads weights once, streams frames through a bounded pipeline, and renders overlays and readouts with clear disclaimers. The experience prioritized education over surveillance-grade precision.

impact.heading: Impact
metrics: 📝 Consent-first copy and fallbacks when models or cameras failed
📦 Bundle discipline while shipping TF.js on consumer hardware
impact.description: An early ML-in-the-browser exercise that still reflects how I approach risky domains: ship clarity, not hype.
